text: Janto an Nulaaɗo, fii Huudi, musiɗɗo Aadinkooɓe ɓen ka dammbe, tuma nde o jertinirnoo yimɓe makko ɓen, e lepte Allah yanooje e maɓɓe, hara hiɓe ka cuuɗi maɓɓe nder ayɗe nano duunde arab nden - gomɗii le Nulaaɓe jertinooɓe goo jertiniino yimɓe mun, ado Huudi e ɓaawo makko, wonnde : wata on rewu dey, si wanaa Allah tun. Min mi hulanii on, onon yimɓe am, lepte ñalaande mawnde, woni Ñalnde Darngal.
